MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable Anker speaker fits my interest in audio accessories and gives me a way to listen away from my desk without wearing headphones.",
    "Audio was a reasonable connection to my headphone purchases, though only the portable speaker offered a use I wanted right now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and smart displays assume I want voice assistance or home automation, but my recent accessories support practical computer and desk tasks.",
    "The Wi-Fi extender does not address an identified problem: my recent adapter and Ethernet cables reflect work on wired connections.",
    "The streaming sticks and tablet do not follow from a specific need; an HDMI cable, Raspberry Pi project, and Kindle do not mean I want more entertainment devices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Amazon-branded purchases seem to have been taken as interest in the wider Alexa and Fire device range.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in connected gadgets, without enough attention to what I use each accessory for."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases concentrate on wired networking, computer cleaning, carrying equipment, and organizing my desk.",
    "My Raspberry Pi, case, and small keyboard belong to a hands-on project; they do not establish a need for a streaming stick.",
    "An audio product feels useful when it adds a listening option, such as portability, rather than requiring an interest in voice control."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics and audio but missed my current focus on practical computer accessories and specific setup needs."
}
